series_identity.acceptance: Exact series and market mapping with source locator; names alone insufficient

return_basis.acceptance: Both sides have independently supported matching economic basis

corporate_action_factors.acceptance: Cover cash and stock dividend, split, capital reduction and par-value change; not inferred from dataset name

dividend_reinvestment.acceptance: Explicit reinvestment semantics; PRICE basis requires supported exclusion/nonapplicability

observation_provenance.acceptance: Positive adjusted values alone insufficient; unchanged values alone do not prove carry

trading_calendar.acceptance: All observations match verified required calendar without fill or window shrinking

revision_history.acceptance: Versioned artifacts and evidence of past availability; declarations are not proof

publication_time.acceptance: Declared as_of and published_at no later than decision cutoff, with independent evidence

automation_limits: Checks declared metadata and consistency only
Does not authenticate references, hashes or statements
Does not audit factor math, source prices, calendars or licenses
Synthetic fixtures only; not wired into calculation wrapper
next_acceptance: Independent evidence review, artifact integrity checks, exact-source sample validation and formal execution review remain separate
